text.tspan: HTTP versions: how requests share connections (A → A = request A, then its response)
Answered IN ORDER: a slow response
ALPN h2. One lost packet still stalls all
Independent streams: a loss stalls only its
own stream; TLS 1.3 built in. Falls back
to HTTP/2 when UDP 443 is blocked
